findings.title: XSS Filter Bypass - Dalgona Challenge #25
findings.description: The /xss25 endpoint implements a server-side XSS filter that blocks certain keywords (script, onerror, onload, onmouseover, single quotes) but fails to block all HTML event handlers. Using onfocus with autofocus or ontoggle with details open tag bypasses the filter and executes JavaScript. The flag is revealed upon successful XSS execution.
